name: Rockland Foodservice
old_description: We fill the gap between the big food distributors and the retail chains you are used to. We aim to Feed Maine (ME) by providing exemplary service and competitive prices.
about:
Rockland Foodservice operates from a store in Rockland, Maine. The business has existed in one form or another since the 1980s, originally as Rockland Wholesale in a building now occupied by J.Edward Knight Insurance, and later next door where CarQuest Auto Parts stands. It is part of a family-owned group that also included Shore Save, a former grocery located where a Rite Aid now stands, and the company has served the Rockland community for decades.

The company functions as a foodservice distributor and retailer, stocking a wide variety of food and beverage items for immediate pickup or curbside collection. It taps into a network of local and out-of-state distributors to source specialty products, typically fulfilling such requests within a few days. The facility also handles bulk and big-pack orders for events such as weddings, parties, and boat trips, with customers able to place orders a week in advance for staged pickup.

Primary customers include local restaurants, hotels, and individual consumers planning large gatherings. The business positions itself between national broadline distributors and conventional retail chains, aiming to serve both commercial foodservice operators and retail shoppers in the mid-coast Maine region.

Rockland Foodservice was founded to fill the gap between large food distributors and retail chains, with a stated mission to "Feed Maine" through exemplary service and competitive prices. The emphasis on personal attention—bending over backwards for each customer, whether new or lifelong—reflects its community-rooted approach.

name: Rockledge Farm Woodworks
old_description: Unlocking the beauty of Vermont Hardwoods, For Those Seeking the Road Less Traveled
about:
Rockledge Farm Woodworks operates from a 200-year-old hill farm in Reading, Vermont, where a family-owned woodworking tradition spans four generations. The business traces its roots to a mail-order venture that sold wooden furniture from the farm, and today the converted barns house workshops, a gallery, and offices for the small, family-operated company.

The workshop produces custom furniture and one-of-a-kind pieces crafted from sustainably harvested Vermont hardwoods such as birdseye maple, curly maple, black walnut, cherry, flame birch, and various burls. Each project begins with hand-selected lumber sourced from small local mills, and the team builds everything from heirloom tables and chairs to accessories including cutting boards, bowls, utensils, jewelry boxes, game boards, and bentwood oval ware. No two pieces are identical; the firm describes its output as “one-of-a-kind, one-at-a-time” handcrafted work.

Customers include private clients who collaborate on custom designs as well as select galleries and stores across the country that carry the accessory line. The company does not operate as a production shop with a fixed catalog; instead, it treats every commission as a fresh start, developing designs directly with the buyer.

The founders’ philosophy centers on letting the wood itself guide the design—unusual live-edge slabs may sit for years until the “proper use becomes apparent”—and on keeping the supply chain local unless a specific material cannot be found in Vermont. This approach, they say, distinguishes them from volume-oriented furniture makers.

about:
Rockler Woodworking and Hardware operates a retail location at 4901 N May Avenue in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma. The store is part of the national Rockler chain, which specializes in woodworking tools, hardware, and supplies.

The Oklahoma City store stocks a wide assortment of Rockler-branded clamps, jigs, glue accessories, and finishing products, alongside brands such as Festool, Blum, and Grass. It provides woodworking classes and workshops for all skill levels, supplying tools and materials for participants. The store also hosts community events, including tool swaps and vendor demonstrations.

Customers range from hobbyists and DIY enthusiasts to professional woodworkers and cabinetmakers. The store’s expanded drawer slide selection and exclusive Rockler products cater to cabinet and furniture makers, while classes attract beginners and experienced makers alike.

The location differentiates itself through hands-on education, community-focused events, and an expanded in-store selection of premium brands like Festool abrasives and track saws, aiming to be a local hub for woodworkers.

name: Rockport Steel
old_description: Rockport Steel, located in Midcoast Maine, specializes in custom metal fabrication projects of all shapes and sizes. We believe everybody should have the ability to construct beautiful metal work.
about:
Rockport Steel operates in Rockport, Maine, on the state's Midcoast. The shop has been producing custom metal fabrications for over 30 years, beginning with a small crew building boats before expanding into structural steel and architectural metalwork. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The company provides forming, welding, cutting, design consulting, shop drawings with 3D modeling, and installation services. Its capabilities cover structural steel fabrication, custom architectural metalwork, railings, stairs, fences, gates, boat components, docks, ramps, commercial signage, and sculptures. A boom truck supports on-site erection. Facility size, headcount, and annual volume are not published.

Rockport Steel serves both commercial and residential clients. Project examples include structural frameworks for buildings, ornamental railings and staircases, perimeter fencing and gates, marine fabrications for boats and docks, custom signs, and artistic sculptures. The firm emphasizes a collaborative approach, working from customer concepts through to finished installation.

The company states its goal is to deliver superior quality and workmanship that exceeds expectations, with a diverse team that brings strong problem-solving skills to each custom design. It positions itself as a resource partner, telling clients: "You provide the vision, we provide the resources."

name: Rogue Welding & Fabrication
old_description: In 2024, we proudly introduced our CNC plasma cutting table, enabling us to take our custom fabrication capabilities to the next level.
about:
Rogue Welding & Fabrication operates from Gardiner, Maine, off Route 201. The company is owned by Devon Sproul, who brings nearly a decade of professional fabrication experience spanning corporate industrial welding and small‑business metal repair. Sproul established the business to offer both in‑shop and mobile welding services across the state.

The shop provides stick (SMAW), MIG (GMAW), and AC/DC TIG (GTAW) welding, along with CNC plasma cutting on a table added in 2024. Work covers aluminum, stainless steel, and carbon steel, ranging from small repairs to full custom fabrication. A portable engine‑driven rig enables on‑site repairs throughout Maine, while the Gardiner facility handles projects of all sizes.

Customers include owners of fishing vessels, work trailers, tow trucks, and snowmobile trailers, as well as residential clients seeking custom signs, fire pits, and home‑garage items. The company also takes on industrial component work and offers on‑site planning consultations for larger projects.

Sproul emphasizes a professional experience and quality on every job, aiming to turn each client’s vision into reality. The 2024 plasma table investment reflects a focus on precision and expanding design capabilities.

name: Rohrer Corporation
old_description: Rohrer Corporation Expands Sustainable Material Options In Its ezCombo® Packaging Program
about:
Rohrer Corporation, headquartered in Warwick, Rhode Island, operates nine manufacturing facilities across the United States and Mexico. The company was founded in 1973 by John and David Rohrer as a family-owned packaging business. In 2021, private equity firm Wellspring Capital Management acquired Rohrer, adding to a growth trajectory that included acquisitions of CardPak (2016), Transparent Container (2018), Coburn Carton (2021), and Jay Packaging (2022).

Rohrer provides retail packaging solutions encompassing design and engineering, printing and thermoforming, tooling and machinery, and technical service assistance. Its capabilities include soft-touch coating, printing on a wide range of substrates, and production tooling. The company runs nine regional facilities in Wadsworth, OH; Hayesville, OH; Addison, IL; Bensenville, IL; Buford, GA; Huntley, IL; Warwick, RI; Mesa, AZ; and Tijuana, B.C., Mexico, though total headcount and annual volume are not disclosed.

The company serves medical and pharmaceutical packaging, cosmetic packaging, and consumer-goods brands. Notable customers referenced include Newell Brands (Sharpie Spinner Pack), Mars Fishcare, and CE Tools. Rohrer's ezCombo® and ecoCombo® programs target brand owners seeking sustainable, cost-effective packaging with rapid turnaround.

Rohrer differentiates itself through its ezCombo® program, which promises speed, quality, and value, and its ecoCombo® program, described as the packaging industry's first post-consumer recycled materials combo offering. The company states a goal of zero product and service defects, 100% on-time delivery, and total customer satisfaction, backed by certifications including ISO 9001:2015, FSC Chain of Custody, and GMI Full Certification.

name: Rowan Company Furniture
old_description: At Rowan Company, we understand that furniture is an investment and the buying process can often be overwhelming.
about:
Rowan Company Furniture operates a showroom and interior design studio in Greenville, South Carolina. The business was founded in 2003 by its current owner, who describes a vision centered on differentiation, fair pricing, and customer care. Over the years the store has evolved while maintaining that original ethos.

The company curates a selection of home furnishings from established brands such as Taylor King, Lee Industries, Sarreid, Uttermost, Visual Comfort, and Woodbridge Furniture, alongside vintage and antique pieces sourced globally. In addition to retail sales, the firm provides interior design services ranging from single-room accessorizing to whole-house projects, supported by a team of designers. The showroom is open Monday through Saturday, with hours posted online.

Rowan Company serves residential clients seeking furniture, lighting, and decor, as well as customers looking for design consultation. Its inventory spans sofas, chairs, tables, beds, chandeliers, and accent pieces, with examples including the Taylor King apartment-size sofa, Lee Industries leather chairs, and Uttermost accent chairs. The business also caters to antique collectors with items such as vintage billiard balls and sideboards.

That philosophy, combined with design expertise, forms the basis of the company's appeal.

name: Royal Automation & Controls
old_description: We carry all the top manufacturers and brands in the business
about:
Royal Automation & Controls operates from Salt Lake City, Utah, where it has served the Wasatch Front since 1957. The branch is part of Consolidated Electrical Distributors, Inc. (CED), a national network of more than 700 locations that supplies residential, commercial, industrial, and solar electrical products.

The company stocks a broad range of industrial electrical supplies and automation equipment, including explosion-proof fittings, PLCs, SCADA platforms, and variable-frequency drives from brands such as Schneider Electric, Square D, Phoenix Contact, Hoffman, and Appleton. In addition to product distribution, it provides VFD programming and start-up commissioning, switchgear and lighting quotations, project management, and industrial agriculture pump support, backed by a large on-site controls inventory.

Customers include industrial and agricultural contractors, OEMs, panel builders, system integrators, and facility operators across sectors such as mining and metals, water and wastewater treatment, oil and gas, and general industrial MRO. The Salt Lake City metro area accounts for the core territory, with the branch positioning itself as a go-to source for industrial automation and control solutions.

Royal Automation & Controls emphasizes a dedicated industrial sales team, quick response times, and delivery service as its primary differentiators, anchored by its long-standing partnership with Schneider Electric’s Altivar drive line.

name: Rubicon Automotive Group
old_description: Founded by George Roeske, Rubicon Automotive Group is a dream that started as a college business plan in 2004 and then became a reality in the summer of 2018.
about:
Rubicon Automotive Group is based in Grants Pass, Oregon. The company was founded by George Roeske and became a reality in the summer of 2018, after the concept originated as a college business plan in 2004. Roeske brought twenty-eight years of experience in the auto recycling industry to the venture, leaving employment to establish his own business.

The company operates as a distributor of quality recycled auto parts, stocking thousands of OEM wheels, truck beds, gates, and powertrain accessories. It purchases repairable OEM wheels from sellers and manages inventory across its own online store, eBay, and the Car-Part network. Orders are typically processed and shipped within one business day, with an emphasis on delivering the correct part on the first attempt.

Rubicon serves automotive repair shops, collision centers, individual vehicle owners, and insurance-related repair needs. Customer testimonials highlight transactions such as a Ford truck take-off box purchase, a replacement wheel for a bent OEM rim, and repeat business from a shop that values fast turnaround and expertise.

The business was started to embed a philosophy of honesty, integrity, and attention to detail into auto parts distribution. Core values cited by the founder include innovation in processes that create customer value, transparency in part information, and accessibility through multiple communication channels.

name: Ruff Tuff Products, LLC

about:
Ruff Tuff Products, LLC operates from West Valley City, Utah, where it designs and manufactures custom seat covers for a range of vehicles including UTVs, side-by-sides, trucks, and Jeeps. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The shop produces made-to-order seat covers through packages such as the Special OPS® Package and Flex OPS™ Package, offering options like quilted inserts, pistol pockets, front and rear pockets, headrest covers, armrest and console covers, and sheepskin upgrades. Customers select fabrics and provide vehicle details for a custom fit via an online configurator; the company also sells hats and accessories. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are published.

Buyers include individual owners of off-road and work vehicles, as well as dealers who resell the covers to their customers. The company highlights its support for the U.S. armed forces, veterans, and first responders through a partnership with Folds of Honor, directing a portion of each purchase to the nonprofit's scholarship fund.

Ruff Tuff emphasizes American manufacturing and installer-friendly design, with testimonials noting precise fit, durable materials, and responsive customer service. Free shipping is offered on orders over $400 within the contiguous United States.
